messages:
Maria: Quick ask 1 drafting a one-page solution brief for enterprise security + SLA needs. Need final wording on SLA and deployment bullets.

Jake: Suggestion: 2-line hero, 3 quick benefit bullets, compact compliance line. Keep "Hosted / Dedicated / Private" phrasing but different descriptors.

Sophia: For webinar follow-up, add an "Evaluation checklist" with 4 items and a CTA to the benchmarking page: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks

Anya: Security wording: "Industry-standard encryption in transit and at rest; optional customer-managed KMS/HSM; audit logs and RBAC." Avoid naming crypto algorithms. Mention data residency and key custody options.

Paul: SLA note: propose example numbers for sales collateral: Dedicated 1 99.9% uptime; Private 1 contractual SLAs; Hosted 1 SLAs available on paid plans. Add short "We provide / customer manages" responsibilities list.

Maria: Drafted compact copy below, please reply with single-line edits only. If no objections by 5pm we'll send to design.

---
ONE-PAGER COMPACT DRAFT (candidate)
Hero: Production-grade LLM inference, predictable economics, enterprise controls.
Top 3 benefits: 1) Rapid integration via Hosted API; 2) Predictable throughput & cost with Dedicated capacity; 3) Air-gapped / VPC options for regulated workloads.
Security & compliance (1 line): Industry-standard encryption in transit & at rest; optional customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM); audit logs and RBAC; documentation available on request.
SLA snapshot: Dedicated: SLA-backed uptime (e.g., 99.9%) and latency SLOs; Private: contract SLAs; Hosted: tiered support with published operational targets.
What we own vs you: We operate model serving, runtime patching, telemetry & rollout tooling. You own sensitive data classification, consent & access policies.
Evaluation checklist: Latency at target token lengths; throughput baseline; rollback / fallback test; KMS + audit log verification.
CTAs: Register for "Enterprise Inference" webinar (link)  Request dedicated POC (link)
---

design-bot: New ticket created in #design-requests for one-pager asset.

deploy-bot: Reminder: attach latest SOC/compliance pack if available.

Sophia: I'll map follow-up emails to routing logic: trials -> nurture one-pager; high-usage -> sales alert; enterprise form -> SE queue.

Maria: Thanks all 1 tagging @Anya @Paul for final SLA & compliance sign-off. :rocket:
